column1: # *** THE ACT THAT ATTACHES THE LERENA TRAIBEL BRANCH TO THE TRUNK. ***
# San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo. TWO baptisms of 12 March 1858 - sisters or twins.
# Priest: Martin Perez. Ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4, full-text transcript read 14 September 2026.
# Found by searching AVELINO with AMBROSIA - not the surname.

*** ALFREDO JUSTINIANO LERENA ***
Ana Rosario
# *** AVELINO LERENA IS A SON OF SANCHO LERENA AND MARIA FERNANDEZ - on a parish act, twice on one
# page. *** This archive has named the "Lerena Traibel" since its first week without ever placing
# Avelino, and as recently as this morning recorded that "no record found here names Avelino's own
# parents, so he is NOT shown to be Sancho's son". He is now.
# So Sancho's children now number FIVE on record: DON LUIS (b. c.1812), JUSTA PASTORA (of Canelones),
# DOMINGA JOSEFA (b. 1804), AVELINO - and the Justinia/Alberto Octavio/Maria Ema/Alejandro group
# belong to Don Luis's own family, not to Sancho's.
# And the whole LERENA TRAIBEL line - Josefa (1851-1947), Alfredo Justiniano (c.1857), Mercedes
# Micaela, Clorinda, Juan Arturo, Andres, Alberto, Adelina, Pedro Alberto Isabelino, Marta Adelina,
# Avelino the younger - descends from Sancho. *** SEVERAL OF THEM WERE ALREADY IN THIS ARCHIVE,
# FLOATING UNATTACHED: *** Mercedes Micaela and Clorinda are in the dispensation table; JUAN ARTURO
# is the man this archive conflated with another Arturo in its first week and had to retract.
# ================ 2. AND THE GODPARENTS ARE LAVALLEJA ================
# *** JUSTINIANO LAVALLEJA, CONSTANTINO LAVALLEJA and ANA LAVALLEJA stood at these two fonts. ***
# Alfredo JUSTINIANO is named for his godfather.
# LAVALLEJA is one of the great names of Uruguayan independence - Juan Antonio Lavalleja led the
# Treinta y Tres Orientales in 1825. *** NOTHING HERE MAKES THESE GODPARENTS HIS IMMEDIATE FAMILY,
# and no relationship is claimed: Lavalleja is a surname, not a proof. *** What IS on the record is
# the pattern, and it is now three deep:
#     1831  FRUCTUOSO RIVERA, President of the Republic, godfather to Sancho's grandson
#     1836  an ORIBE for the bride of Sancho's son Luis
#     1858  LAVALLEJA godparents to Sancho's grandchildren
# *** RIVERA, ORIBE AND LAVALLEJA ARE THE THREE CAUDILLOS OF URUGUAYAN INDEPENDENCE AND OF THE WARS
# THAT FOLLOWED IT. *** This archive spent a fortnight treating the Lerenas as obscure. In three
# generations they stand at fonts with all three houses.
# Alfredo's middle name JUSTINIANO looked like an echo of JUSTINIANA LENGUAS, who married into the
# OTHER branch - and that would have been a tidy connection. It is nothing of the kind: he is named
# for his godfather Justiniano Lavalleja, on the same line of the same act.
# New people on the Traibel side: JUAN TRAIBEL and YSABEL CENTENO, Ambrosia's parents; and POLONIA
# TRAIBEL, godmother, presumably her sister.
